UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Snapsec user profile synced from Google Sign-In.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

name.description: Display name of the authenticated user.

email.description: Verified email address of the authenticated user.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents accessible only by the authenticated owner.
